title: Add LOG_WRN to (void) casts in link_ctx.c
description: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/link_ctx.c has 9 instances of (void)save_tuple(ctx) and (void)seq_unlock(ctx) that silently discard errors. Add LOG_WRN before each (void) cast: capture the return value, log if nonzero, then continue. Pattern: int err = save_tuple(ctx); if (err) { LOG_WRN("save_tuple failed: errno=%d", err); }. Keep the ignore-and-continue behavior — just make it visible. Verify: build host C tests for link module.
